name: io.github.ZenRows/zenrows-mcp
description: Zenrows MCP server — Fetch, Extract, Batch, and Browser Sessions for AI coding assistants

environmentVariables.description: Optional Zenrows API key (https://app.zenrows.com/account/settings). If unset, stdio auto-provisions a Free account unless ZENROWS_AUTO_SIGNUP=false.
environmentVariables.name: ZENROWS_API_KEY

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <ZENROWS_API_KEY>, or use OAuth in clients that support it. Remote MCP does not auto-create accounts.
